evals.prompt: Audit eval1_combine_closures.swift for ARC retain cycles and memory leak hazards across closures and Combine subscriptions.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying Combine assign(to:on: self), .sink without weak self, and closure property strong retention, categorized by severity with surgical fixes.
expectations: Identifies Combine assign(to:on: self) as a critical retain cycle
Identifies Combine .sink closure capturing self strongly without [weak self]
Identifies escaping closure property onProfileUpdated capturing self strongly
Provides surgical code fixes using [weak self] and assign(to: &$username)

evals.prompt: Audit eval2_delegates_timers_gcd.swift for memory leaks, delegate cycles, timer retain hazards, and delayed GCD retention.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging strong delegate property, Timer.scheduledTimer with strong target, DispatchSourceTimer retain cycle, and asyncAfter delayed retention.
expectations: Identifies strong delegate property missing 'weak' keyword
Identifies repeating Timer.scheduledTimer retaining self in RunLoop
Identifies DispatchSourceTimer setEventHandler capturing self strongly
Identifies DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter retaining self across long delay
Recommends weak delegate, block-based Timer/WeakProxy, and weak self captures

evals.prompt: Audit eval3_autorelease_bloat.swift for memory bloat, high-water mark loops, unbounded caches, and Core Data fault accumulation.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying missing @autoreleasepool in image batch processing, unbounded dictionary cache, and Core Data batch loop without context.reset().
expectations: Identifies batch photo processing loop lacking @autoreleasepool causing JetSam risk
Identifies unbounded dictionary cache used instead of NSCache
Identifies Core Data fetch loop lacking context.reset() or refreshAllObjects()
Recommends @autoreleasepool wrapping, NSCache migration, and batch context resets

evals.prompt: Audit eval4_concurrency_cf_webkit.swift for WebKit script message handler leaks, discarded observer tokens, and unmanaged CoreFoundation leaks.
